title: Harden web tool UI and URL rendering
description: Apply the reviewed follow-ups: share safe URL rendering across web_search, web_research, and web_fetch; make long URL truncation explicit/non-misleading; expose source enrichment in the TUI; mark fetch previews as truncated; and make omitted answer links explicit. Preserve structured details and untrusted-content boundaries.

logs.msg: Implemented shared safe URL rendering for all three web tools, explicit shortened/unlisted source markers, source enrichment previews in web_search, and fetch preview truncation notices. Added deterministic regression coverage; bun run check passes (204 tests, 500 assertions).
Follow-up tightened compact web_fetch URL previews with the same explicit shortening marker; full check still passes.
